recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future changes to the contents of the example security-label value sets should be handled through Security WG terminology trackers, not by reopening this OO DocumentReference binding-strength issue.
issue_request: FHIR-32586 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification OO change request for DocumentReference.securityLabel. The Jira issue objected that the broad Security Labels value set was not coherent or mappable enough for an extensible binding, and the accepted resolution was to make the value set example while OO worked with Security on a better example set.
initial_application: The Jira application comment points to merge commit 8d1cf2b00809434f98fd4f14c874c7837a19389b. The underlying issue-branch content commit 3a3e468b4b4a94054cfe4b1d919e893ab935a4d1 changed DocumentReference.securityLabel binding strength from extensible to example while still referencing the broad security-labels value set.
additional_context: DocumentReference is active in source/fhir.ini. Security WG issue FHIR-32471 later required elements using the broad HCS security-labels value set to use a new example value set; commit cd1c06923912f70a88c90d186ff3283b40e0403b updated DocumentReference to an example security-label value set, and 2025 commits 7231f4c27ab62fe032fd52c0e233c6955da6f295 and 20519d082a70e510caf4b497b616ec3946b302a2 normalized the current singular security-label-example URL. OO Confluence minutes confirm the FHIR-32586 block vote, and Zulip searches found only pre-issue discussion of the old extensible binding rather than a later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current active source has DocumentReference.securityLabel binding strength example and valueSet http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/security-label-example; the bound value set is an explicitly experimental example set, so the current source satisfies FHIR-32586 after later Security WG terminology refinement.
